description: Header file defining the QuicDefaultClient class, a client implementation for QUIC protocol, including constructors, destructor, and methods for creating sessions and accessing network helper.

classes.name: QuicDefaultClient
classes.description: A client class for QUIC protocol, capable of establishing connections, managing sessions, and providing network helper access.

methods.name: QuicDefaultClient
methods.description: Constructors for QuicDefaultClient with various configurations, including default network helper ownership transfer.

methods.name: CreateQuicClientSession
methods.description: Creates and returns a new QuicSession for the client.

methods.name: GetLatestFD
methods.description: Returns the latest file descriptor from the default network helper.

methods.name: default_network_helper
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the network helper used by the client.
